_doc: Verification gates (run with python3 .claude/bin/gates.py fast|full; evidence in .git/claude-evidence/; the Stop hook checks completion claims against `full`). STUB until P02.02.02: the 'workspace' gate fails until the Turborepo tasks exist, so `full` cannot pass and no session can claim green before P02 lands. P02.02.02 replaces 'workspace' with the QG-01 set (format, lint, typecheck, unit, integration on real PG17+pgvector, build, gitleaks) and adds a `stress` section. Keep 'control-plane' first. Never delete or weaken a gate to make `full` pass (loosening needs founder approval).

gates.name: control-plane-lint
gates.run: uvx ruff@0.15.12 format --check --config .claude/ruff.toml .claude && uvx ruff@0.15.12 check --config .claude/ruff.toml .claude && uvx --from mypy==2.3.1 mypy --config-file .claude/mypy.ini

gates.name: workspace
gates.run: pnpm turbo run lint typecheck test build
